page.notes: The first word of the page is printed with a long s, transcribed as "sit"; the scan is faint there. "immiscer" and "spondeo" are read from the scan as printed. "ne[?]" is a doubtful reading of the word after "rixantes prohibere potuissent," which looks like "ne" but may be a worn letter. The running head ends in a mark that may be a dagger (†) after "VOET"; I have not transcribed it. The word "quibus" is hyphenated across the line end; "bus" is the catchword at the foot.
